{{Top}}
{{Citation}}
[[File:Luke_gunner_01.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Luke Skywalker defends [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] using a turret-mounted laser cannon.]]
{{Quote|Target, maximum firepower.|Maximilian Veers|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
A '''laser cannon''' was the standard weapon for use by most [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and other vehicles. The amount of destruction a laser cannon could do depended on its wattage. Cannons on the famous X-Wing ranged from 126 terawatts to 500 terawatts. Turbo laser cannons on Imperial Star Destroyers were upwards of 3,000 terawatts. It existed in a myriad of forms, from the huge versions used by starships, through medium-sized turret-mounted variants, to the much smaller personal [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]] sometimes carried by infantry. Although they were capable of causing a considerable amount of damage, they were no match to some of the more advanced beam weapons such as [[Electromagnetic plasma cannon/Legends|electromagnetic plasma cannons]], [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] and [[Superlaser/Legends|superlasers]].

==Description==
[[File:ATAT-hlc.png|thumb|left|200px|Chin-mounted heavy laser cannons class-II on an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]].]]
Laser cannons were the most commonly-used starship weapon throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They ranged from low-power weapons that were mounted on independent [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] such as [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] to military-grade versions found on [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]]. Laser cannons were more powerful versions of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], and followed similar design principles.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

Laser cannons were fed power from a [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]] or main [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]]. [[Blaster gas/Legends|Blaster gas]] was stored in supercooled and puncture-proof [[Gas chamber|chambers]]. The blaster gas was energized by a powerful charge in the laser cannon's [[Laser actuator/Legends|laser actuator]], and the [[Prismatic crystal/Legends|prismatic crystal]] in the actuator produced the high-energy beam of charged particles. The beam was then fed through the laser [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]] lined with [[galven coil]]s and [[Galven circuit/Legends|circuitry]] to maintain its cohesion before being released from the [[Laser tip/Legends|laser tip]].<ref name="EGWT" />

The weapons were generally light with a high rate of fire. They were most effective against [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and other light vessels. However, laser cannons could not penetrate high-power [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] or damage thick [[Armor/Legends|armor]] plating. Laser cannons generated a vast amount of waste heat during the energy conversion process, requiring an extensive and sophisticated cooling system that protected the weapon's internal components.<ref name="EGWT" />

The energy beams produced by laser cannons were configured to be visible on the light spectrum as [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] often preferred visual sighting during combat. The cannons were connected to combat [[Computer/Legends|computers]] which worked in conjunction with turret servos to make minor adjustments that ensured accuracy during operation.<ref name="EGWT" />

Laser cannons were originally used by [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to blast debris, such as asteroids, out of their way. These cannons were both incredibly destructive and very accurate.

==History==
[[File:Snowspeeder_2.png|thumb|right|300px|Two heavy laser cannons point forward on the T-47 airspeeder]]
Starships, such as the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Super Star Destroyer]], [[Viscount-class Star Defender|''Viscount''-class Star Defender]] and the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]], began using laser cannons as anti-[[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] defenses. These weapons were later engineered to fire beams with sufficient accuracy and power to intercept enemy missiles from long range: the [[Point-defense laser cannon/Legends|point-defense cannon]], mounted on [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] [[Crusader-class corvette|''Crusader''-class corvettes]], was an example.

Eventually, laser cannon technology was so refined that ground-based vehicles such as the [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] could use them. Even some infantry, such as [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B-2 battle droids]], could be equipped with laser cannons rather than personal blasters. [[D'harhan]], a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], sported a laser cannon that had been surgically attached to his body, replacing his head.<ref name="TMA">''[[The Mandalorian Armor]]''</ref> Around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], [[Holowan Laboratories/Legends|Holowan Laboratories]] created the [[IG-88 assassin droid/Legends|IG-88]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] series that featured a repeating laser cannon mounted along each arm.
